The index accumulates use and awake rest. Usage penalties accelerate every 15 minutes after 30 minutes; 15 minutes of rest removes one acceleration stage. Estimated sleep holds both the index and recovery burden. Checks lasting up to one minute only incur an opening penalty. Results settle about two minutes later to identify brief checks. This is not a sleep measurement.

Find DigitsCore in the list and turn on Allow.
Usage data stays on your device

App names, usage time, app-open counts, and observed unlock events are used to calculate your score. Nothing is sent to the developer or a server, and you can turn off access and tracking at any time.
Required to measure the app currently visible on screen in real time.
Shows your live score in the status bar and detects overuse.

When Usage Access is granted, DigitsCore reads app names, package names, observed unlock events, and usage sessions and open counts for the top app while the screen is on and unlocked. Background playback with the screen off is not measured.
This data is used only to calculate digital-use patterns and display scores and statistics in the app and notifications.

Results and settings are stored in an on-device SQLCipher-encrypted database protected by Android Keystore. Detailed sessions and five-minute scores last 30 days; hourly and daily usage, opens, scores and loss summaries last 365 days; minimal unlock and notification events last 48 hours. They are excluded from OS backup and device transfer. Nothing is sent to a server. Manual backups use password-based AES-256-GCM encryption.

Detailed sessions and five-minute Core Index samples are retained for 30 days, minimal unlock and notification events for 25 hours, and daily usage and open-count aggregates for 365 days. An encrypted export includes details available at export time. You can hide lock-screen details, stop tracking, delete all history immediately, or revoke access in Android settings.
